people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour.
translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
translations.asv: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And the servant was healed in that hour.
